text:
Leah (Marketing): :wave: Heads up — planning a short-format APAC-friendly webinar (target Wed Jun 3 08:00 JST). Goal: quick run-through of Redwood inference for APAC dev teams, concise demo, and clear routing to SDRs. Quick decisions needed: 30min vs 45min, live demo only or live demo + recorded fallback, and run-of-show draft. Also need inbound lead routing and UTM plan. Thoughts?

Omar (Growth): Lean 30min. APAC registrants prefer concise sessions. Short demo + live Q&A with a recorded fallback sounds right to me. :+1:

Kai (Eng): @Leah I can do a ~12min live demo showing latency & cost tradeoffs and the autoscaling story. I need a canary dataset and a stable demo env. Strong +1 on recorded fallback in case infra flares.

Nina (Prod Ops): Rehearsal scheduling note — because this hits APAC morning and US late-night, propose two rehearsals: a tech check aligned with the live time and a full run earlier. Proposed slots: Jun 2 04:00 PDT (tech check, mirrors live) and Jun 2 12:00 PDT (full run). I'll send invites once we lock.

Sam (Events): Draft run-of-show (30min):
- 00:00-02:00 quick welcome + goals
- 02:00-12:00 demo (Kai)
- 12:00-18:00 customer mini-case (pre-recorded)
- 18:00-28:00 live Q&A + CTA
- 28:00-30:00 wrap + next steps
Anyone want to tweak ordering or timing?

Omar (Growth): Recommend moving the customer case earlier to set context: intro, case, demo, Q&A. So demo 06:00-16:00, case 16:00-22:00, Q&A 22:00-30:00. Shortens switching friction.

Leah (Marketing): I like that ordering. Also need an explicit fallback plan: if live demo fails, we play a 3-min recorded walkthrough then extend Q&A to cover gaps. Alex — can you own lead routing and tags in HubSpot?

Alex (SDR): Yep. Proposed form fields: 'interest_level' (pilot / eval / enterprise), 'region', 'use_case'. Auto-tag every lead with 'webinar-apac'. If we play the fallback clip, add tag 'demo-fallback-played'. SDR follow-up: 24h touch for pilot leads, 72h for enterprise. I'll draft the workflow and share.

Kai (Eng): For the fallback I'll prepare a tight 3-min trimmed clip of the live demo and a separate 2-min "what changed" clip that highlights the key metrics (latency, tokens/sec, cost delta). Will upload to GDrive and share links by Jun 1.

Leah (Marketing): Promo copy options — two headlines to A/B test in the invite: 1) 'Serve LLMs with predictable latency across regions' 2) 'Reduce inference costs without sacrificing latency' Which should we run to the developer list vs platform buyers? Also need APAC-friendly send time for invites.

Omar (Growth): Use headline #1 for developer/devex audiences, #2 for platform/infra buyers. We'll A/B test in the invite. Send cadence: invite + reminder 24h before + 1 hour before.

Sam (Events): Rehearsals: can we simulate a mid-demo failure during the full run so ops and hosts practice the cut-to-recorded flow? @Kai can flip to the fallback clip in rehearsal.

Nina (Prod Ops): Yes — we'll run a simulated GPU OOM during the rehearsal to force the fallback. Ops will run the script and coordinate with Kai's demo env. I'll include the simulate-failure steps in the rehearsal agenda.

Leah (Marketing): Action items (due Jun 1):
- Kai: demo env + fallback clips uploaded
- Alex: HubSpot form, tags & SDR workflow + UTM params
- Nina: calendar invites + simulate-failure script
- Sam: final run-of-show slides + CTAs and slide deck
- Omar: A/B copy for invites and reminder cadence
I'll assemble the final run-of-show after confirmations. :calendar:

Alex (SDR): Added to my board. Quick Q re: UTM — recommend: utm_campaign=apac-webinar2026&utm_source=invite&utm_medium=email. Also set lead source field = webinar-apac in HubSpot.

Leah (Marketing): Perfect — use that UTM and lead source. If anyone has timing conflicts for rehearsals, flag now. Final note: let's keep the talk heavy on practical tradeoffs (latency, cost, deploy modes) — APAC dev teams care about predictable operational behavior.

Sam (Events): I'll post the rehearsal agenda and failure simulation checklist to the calendar invites once Nina confirms the time.

Omar (Growth): :thumbsup: Great plan. Looking forward to the A/B copy.

Leah (Marketing): Thanks team — ping me in thread with any updates.
